rules.description: Do not install or execute third-party GitHub skills directly from search results.
Review scripts for network calls, shell execution, file writes, credential access, browser profile access, and persistence hooks before allowlisting.
Run new skills only in a disposable workspace with no production secrets or logged-in browser profile.
Grant each role only the tool permissions required for its responsibility.
Publishing, external replies, payment registration, and credential changes require CEO approval.
